CA.name: False unicorn root
CA.citation: Database of Vascular Plants of Canada (VASCAN), accepted species record for Chamaelirium luteum; native range is a marginal, historically-documented population in southern Ontario

US.name: False unicorn root
US.citation: United Plant Savers, species conservation profile for Chamaelirium luteum. Name deliberately preferred over bare 'unicorn root', 'starwort' or 'stargrass' - 19th-century Eclectic medical literature (King's American Dispensatory) and modern sources document extensive, long-documented transposition of these shared names with the unrelated Aletris farinosa ('true unicorn root')
